Over the years, I have tried many different shampoos, conditioners, masks, and hair treatments but In spite of my efforts, combing my hair (especially right after shampooing) has always resulted in a nightmare of tangles—until I tried this product. claims.text: Many reviewers praise the product for leaving hair soft, healthy, and full, with several citing long-term use of many years.
A common complaint is that the product is overpriced, especially for the 16 oz size, with some noting better deals elsewhere.
Some reviewers note that you do not need to use as much product as the bottle directions suggest.
A few reviewers report negative experiences, including illegible directions and hair falling out.
